note: Lower Loup NRD recreation area (NGPC until 2012) on 24-acre Pibel Lake in south-west Wheeler County, ~9 mi south of Bartlett. Camping in the trees on the west side of the lake, no pads. Vault toilet, picnic shelter at the south end, pedestrian bridge at the north end, two ADA fishing piers, boat ramp. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview (down). LLNRD says only 'campgrounds on the west side of the lake'; there is no site map (the linked lake map is a 2003 depth chart). On imagery the camping area is a set of gravel loops in the trees west of the lake around a vault toilet at ~41.7572,-98.5325, ~30-70 m from the water. Between them and the lake: the park drive running along the west shore and the mown peninsula carrying the path to a fishing pier, which is day use (one of the 'two ADA compliant fishing piers'). The stored evidence's 'open grass apron to waterline' is the strip beside that drive, and nothing shows campers parked there (rule 001.05B: designated sites only). The loops' east ends open onto that lawn with the lake beyond, so lakeview holds; on-water does not.
